About

Physician working in AI-based clinical research

I work as Project Research Scientist I in the Department of Neurology at AIIMS New Delhi, on Spiral Dx [RE-AI-LTI], a study of AI-based tremor detection. My role sits in the community arm of data collection: I supervise the PTS staff gathering field data, check that what they record is complete and correctly entered, and screen community participants for eventual recruitment into the study.

That sits on top of earlier experience contributing to published clinical studies (participant recruitment, informed consent, ethics documentation, and data collection), and independent work of my own: a longitudinal biostatistics analysis in endometriosis, an ongoing population-health analysis using NHANES data, a research-informatics prototype (REMIT), and the early design of a behavioural study on interpersonal trauma and trust.

My clinical background is general practice: over a thousand telemedicine consultations, a rotatory internship, and an observership in addiction medicine at NIMHANS. I have also designed a small number of health- and community-related concepts, including a family-support application and a civic safety network shortlisted at a hackathon.

01 · Published Research

Published research, as contributor

A published clinical study I contributed to as part of a research team, covering recruitment, informed consent, ethics documentation, and data collection. Not independently authored work.

Contributor

Occupational Ocular Injury Awareness: A Cross-Sectional Study

Chettinad Hospital & Research Institute · 2026 · 150 participants

Hospital-based observational study of 150 workers presenting with occupational ocular injuries. Although 81.3% had heard of occupational eye injuries, 65.3% were unaware of their long-term consequences, 36.7% did not regularly use eye protection, and 49.3% had received no training in its use, identifying a clear gap between awareness and safe practice.

My role: participant recruitment, informed consent, ethics documentation, questionnaire administration to 150 participants, and data entry.

03 · Independent Data Projects

Epidemiology & biostatistics, independently conducted

Two completed quantitative analyses conducted independently, covering longitudinal mixed-effects modelling and survey-weighted population-health epidemiology.

Analysis Completed

Longitudinal Pain and Well-Being Analysis in Endometriosis (KI EndoLIST v1.0.0)

PhysioNet · 2026

Within-patient linear mixed model across 5,112 patient-days from 34 patients, with patient-level cluster bootstrap inference (2,000 resamples). A 10% rise in a patient’s daily maximum pain above their own average was associated with a 0.0128-point fall in rescaled emotional well-being (β = −0.1277, 95% CI −0.1585 to −0.0978), adjusting for menstruation, cycle day, study-day trend, and report-scale group. Associational only. The source data is restricted under a PhysioNet DUA, so the repository ships code and aggregate results with no individual-level data.

Repository ↗
Analysis Completed

Periodontal Disease and Glycemic Health: A Population-Based NHANES Analysis

NHANES 2009–2014 · Independent Research Project · 2026

Survey-weighted cross-sectional analysis of 11,504 dentate adults aged 30+ across NHANES 2009–2014, using CDC/AAP 2012 periodontitis definitions and Taylor-linearised design-based estimation. In the fully adjusted model, severe periodontitis was associated with higher HbA1c (+0.156%, 95% CI 0.058 to 0.254) and moderate disease with +0.072% (95% CI 0.023 to 0.121), with the association holding on exclusion of known diabetes. Documents a probing-depth calibration artefact across cycles and declines to present cross-cycle trends as a result.

Repository ↗
04 · Independent Research Informatics

REMIT: Research Execution, Modification & Implementation Tracker

An independently built prototype for a practical problem in study execution: tracking the downstream effect of a mid-study protocol change.

Independent · 2026 · Prototype

REMIT tracks what a mid-study protocol amendment actually affects: which forms, sites, and consented participants need action, and what was changed by whom. A self-built prototype shown with a synthetic example study, not a deployed or validated system.

Amendment impactWhat each protocol change affects, accepted or still open
Consent & readinessVersioned consent history, per-site study readiness
Audit trail & exportEvery status change timestamped; CSV reporting
05 · Independent Concept

Haelo: A Family-Support Concept

A health/family-support product concept exploring how parents and children might navigate developmental and emotional challenges together, alongside the published clinical research above.

Independent concept

Parents navigating a child's emotional or developmental challenges usually have fragments of information: a doctor's note, a school comment, a late-night search. Haelo's concept connects those fragments: gentle daily check-ins, plain-language help making sense of a difficult moment, and one small next step, alongside a parallel space where the child experiences the same support as play.

3 core questionsHow's my child doing? What does it mean? What now?
Dual-mode designParent dashboard + child's own "Little Adventures"
Research angleLongitudinal behaviour + intervention engagement data

06 · Civic Safety Concept

HAVEN: Proactive Urban Safety and Community Safe Haven Network

A proposed civic safety concept, shortlisted for Round 2 of the Youth for Action Hackathon (ICLEI South Asia). It is not an implemented citywide system.

Team Avia · Shortlisted, Round 2

Existing safety systems (SOS apps, CCTV, FIR) act after danger occurs. HAVEN proposes indexing the safe refuge that already exists (pharmacies, petrol pumps, lodge receptions, roughly every 200 metres) into a live, accountable network. No new infrastructure, just a verified handshake between a citizen who needs refuge and a business willing to open its door. The material below is the presentation and pilot proposal as submitted to the hackathon.

≤3 minProposed metric: Time-to-Refuge
TiruchirappalliProposed pilot city
3 tiersProposed Safe Haven certification levels
